result.title: CueSplat: Learning to Schedule Sparse Deformation for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting on Edge Devices
result.summary: Deformation-based 4D Gaussian splatting (4DGS) enables dynamic scene rendering. However, evaluating deformation networks for all Gaussians at every frame is compute-intensive on edge devices. We find that Gaussian trajectories are often locally predictable, yet prediction reliability varies across Gaussians and time. Thus, we propose CueSplat, a post-training framework that exploits local temporal regularity while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen and retaining its Gaussian set. Specifically, CueSplat predicts Gaussian attributes from recent history and uses a lightweight learned router to select exact deformation updates within a scene-specific budget calibrated offline. Selection accounts for prediction reliability and rendering contribution. Selected indices are reused across nearby frames to reduce routing overhead, while selected Gaussians still receive exact updates each frame. To control accumulated prediction error, we use drift signals to schedule three consecutive full-deformation frames that rebuild the prediction history. Evaluated across four mainstream 4DGS algorithms, CueSplat achieves up to $6.74\times$ and $8.15\times$ speedups on Jetson AGX Orin and Orin NX, respectively, with a negligible quality drop (at most $0.16$ dB in dataset-average PSNR).

AI.brief_summary: CueSplat 面向边缘设备上的动态 4D 高斯泼溅，在冻结预训练骨干的前提下，用历史帧预测高斯属性，并通过轻量学习型 router 在离线标定的预算内挑选需要精确形变更新的高斯，配合索引复用与漂移触发的全量更新帧来控制累积误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“按预测可靠性与渲染贡献决定哪些单元获得精确更新、并周期性全量重算”的调度思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的选择性刷新、缓存复用与停止/重建时机提供概念参照，但该文并无多模态推理证据，需较多核查。
